operator_guidance.label: Ultralytics YOLO11s model prompt
operator_guidance.text: The intended model is YOLO11s, already exported to ONNX at ${ULTRALYTICS_YOLO11S_DATA}/yolo11s-export_train_head-dynamic-v8.3.86.onnx. Use that file. Do not use the YOLO11n examples from the Dockerfile or the docs, do not export a new model from yolo11s.pt, and do not change the Poetry or runtime dependencies. If you need the model at a stable path inside the repo, copy it there.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Pre-exported YOLO11s ONNX artifact staged into the Ultralytics QA workspace so the agent can select an existing model instead of exporting one during QA.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: The exported YOLO11s ONNX is staged at ${ULTRALYTICS_YOLO11S_DATA}/yolo11s-export_train_head-dynamic-v8.3.86.onnx.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Cognata frames + per-frame annotations. UNREACHABLE as of 2026-07-29: the data exists only in the private GCS bucket gs://webinar-datasets (webinar/config.yml BUCKET_NAME) under s3_data/From-Algo/OD_partial2/, and no identity available to us can list or read it. Unblocked by either an admin on the owning GCP project granting access, or a populated ~/Tensorleap_data_3/webinar-datasets cache from a machine that once ran this integration. Until then the fixture cannot produce a valid verdict — this entry exists so it stays out of the default no-creds set and run.sh fails fast with PREREQ-FAIL instead of letting the agent burn a session on the same wall.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Point ${WEBINAR_DATA} at a directory holding the Cognata tree rooted at s3_data/From-Algo/OD_partial2/ (frames, per-frame annotation files, and foresight_unlabeled_paths.txt, which leap_binder.py reads as the unlabeled index). Note webinar/utils/gcs_utils.py resolves $HOME/Tensorleap_data_3/<BUCKET_NAME>/<path> first and only calls GCS on a cache miss, so a populated cache from any machine that ran this integration is a complete copy of everything the fixture touches. Do not attempt to download from GCS during the run.

operator_guidance.label: webinar operator brief
operator_guidance.text: YOLOv7 object detector (`model/yolov7-webinar.h5`) on Cognata synthetic frames; pair each frame with its matching file in the per-frame annotations directory. The YOLO decode helpers need the separate `code-loader-helpers` pip package (they import as `code_loader.helpers` but are NOT part of core `code_loader`).

operator_guidance.label: YOLOv5 VisDrone dataset prompt
operator_guidance.text: This fixture uses the VisDrone2019-DET dataset described by data/VisDrone.yaml. A deterministic 48-image subset is already extracted to ${YOLOV5_VISDRONE_DATA}/VisDrone — set the `path` field in data/VisDrone.yaml to that directory. The checked-in `path` is a developer-local absolute path; ignore it. Do not download the public multi-GB VisDrone archives. ${YOLOV5_VISDRONE_DATA}/VisDrone/yolov5s-visdrone.pt is available for the legacy loss loader.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Compressed deterministic VisDrone2019-DET QA subset staged from the Concierge QA assets bucket and extracted into the QA workspace. The full public archives are multi-GB, so routine QA uses this pre-converted subset instead of downloading VisDrone in every run.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: The VisDrone dataset root is ${YOLOV5_VISDRONE_DATA}/VisDrone; point data/VisDrone.yaml `path` at it rather than the checked-in developer-local path. It also contains yolov5s-visdrone.pt for the legacy loss loader.

operator_guidance.label: cifar10_resnet operator brief
operator_guidance.text: Intended model is the committed Keras ResNet at `model/resnet.h5` (push with `--type H5_TF2`); its output is softmax probabilities, not logits. CIFAR-10 needs no manual dataset staging — it is fetched at runtime (keras) into the data volume.

operator_guidance.label: imdb operator brief
operator_guidance.text: The repo ships three model artifacts under `model/`; integrate `model/fabriceyhc-bert-imdb.onnx` (the BERT sentiment ONNX), not the `.h5` variants. Its inputs are int64 but code_loader encoders must return float32, so wrap/cast the model inputs. Task: binary sentiment (positive/negative).

operator_guidance.label: renault operator brief
operator_guidance.text: InternImage image classifier (`assets/model_portble.onnx`, with `id2class.npy` for labels). The model was trained on RGB — the repo's `cls_process` feeds BGR, but use RGB (the model is the source of truth). Exclude the `Subsign` class (present in the data but has no model GT index).

runtime_prerequisites.description: Private Renault traffic-sign classification images. The model and label map ship in the repo, so only Dataset/ is staged. ALLOWLISTED ON PURPOSE: the bucket root also holds tl_initial_integration.zip and tl_integration_v2.zip, which are reference Tensorleap integrations — staging the whole bucket would hand the agent the solution and void the eval. Never widen this to a bare bucket sync.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: The staged data directory ${RENAULT_DATA} holds Dataset/ — one subfolder per traffic-sign class. The model and its label map come from the repo itself.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Private Infineon TS parquet data and generated sidecar outputs staged into the QA repo.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use ${INFINEON_TS_DATA}/ts as the data directory: set project_config.yaml data.data_path to ${INFINEON_TS_DATA}/ts/combined_training_data_sample_5pct.parquet and data.data_unlabeled.folder_name to ${INFINEON_TS_DATA}/ts/unlabeled. Keep model.model_path as model/enhanced_trial_19_full_model_complete.onnx. If the latent/discriminator/reconstruction .npy sidecars are missing from the staged data, generate them into a writable path and update project_config.yaml consistently before running the integration test.

operator_guidance.label: infineon_ts operator brief
operator_guidance.text: ONNX time-series model (`model/enhanced_trial_19_full_model_complete.onnx`) for Infineon wire-bond sensor data. `config.py` reads `project_config.yaml` (kept in the repo) for the data/model contract; inputs are two traces (current + deformation), output is a shear-value regression. Labeled parquet + `unlabeled/` parquets are staged in the data volume.

operator_guidance.label: Asensus toy lung-anatomy data paths
operator_guidance.text: Use ${ASENSUS_SEGMENTATION_DATA}/asensus/toy_dataset/lung-anatomy as both data_dir and lobe_data_dir. For the split lists in asensus_code_space/config.json use ${ASENSUS_SEGMENTATION_DATA}/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_train_ids.txt, ${ASENSUS_SEGMENTATION_DATA}/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_val_ids.txt and ${ASENSUS_SEGMENTATION_DATA}/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_test_ids.txt. Do not use the checked-in /mnt/DLST81/... paths.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Private Asensus toy lung-anatomy dataset and split lists staged into the QA repo.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use ${ASENSUS_SEGMENTATION_DATA}/asensus/toy_dataset/lung-anatomy as data_dir and lobe_data_dir, and the three lung-anatomy_{train,val,test}_ids.txt files under ${ASENSUS_SEGMENTATION_DATA}/asensus/train_ids/ for the split lists in asensus_code_space/config.json. Do not use the checked-in /mnt/DLST81/... paths.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Trained XLM-RoBERTa NER ONNX model (~1.03 GB) plus the processed MEDDOCAN splits. The source repo gitignores model artifacts (uploaded to Tensorleap separately), so the model is staged from public S3 rather than committed. The dataset is NOT in S3 — the repo builds it itself via scripts/prepare_data.py, which pulls the public (ungated) HuggingFace dataset bigbio/meddocan and writes one pickle per split. prepare.sh runs that builder only when the pickles are absent, so the download happens once per machine rather than once per run.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: The model artifact is staged at ${NER_ROBERTA_DATA}/ner_roberta.onnx and the dataset pickles at ${NER_ROBERTA_DATA}/training.pkl and ${NER_ROBERTA_DATA}/validation.pkl. Set NER_MODEL_PATH to the ONNX path and NER_DATASET_DIR to ${NER_ROBERTA_DATA} (ner_roberta/config.py reads both; its in-repo defaults point at paths that do not exist here). Do not train or re-export the model, and do not re-run the data builder — the pickles are already there.

operator_guidance.label: ner_roberta operator brief
operator_guidance.text: The model is NOT committed — it is a staged ~1 GB XLM-RoBERTa NER ONNX; point `config.py` at it via `NER_MODEL_PATH` (the in-repo default path is wrong). The dataset (`training.pkl`/`validation.pkl`) is staged in the same directory — set `NER_DATASET_DIR` to it. `code-loader` is not pinned in the repo — add it. Task: 3-class BIO token classification (MEDDOCAN).

operator_guidance.label: clinical_assertion operator brief
operator_guidance.text: ONNX 3-class assertion classifier (`model/model.onnx`; float32 input, 3-class logits Absent/Hypothetical/Present). Data and `config.json` (the model I/O contract) are committed in the repo under `data/processed/` — no external dataset is needed.
